objectives.title: Root the machine
objectives.prompt: Get a root shell on the Metasploitable 3 Ubuntu machine and read /root/flag.txt.
hints: Start with a full service scan: several services run software versions with well-known public advisories.
The IRC server and the FTP server both run versions with famous CVEs; the Metasploitable 3 wiki lists the intended vulnerabilities.
A foothold may land you as an unprivileged user: look for a local privilege escalation path to root.

steps.title: Fingerprint the IRC server
steps.prompt: Which IRC server software answers on port 6697? (name only)

steps.title: IRC server version
steps.prompt: Which version of that IRC server is running?

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: What kind of weakness does that release carry, inserted into its source distribution? (one word)

steps.title: Another way in
steps.prompt: ProFTPD 1.3.5 on port 21 ships a module that copies files on the server without logging in. Which module?
